Blanca Max portfolio

Division mission

Blanca Max Bleach's mission is to provide the highest quality, lowest cost specialty bleach for the chemical industry. We exist to attract and maintain customers. With strict adherence to this maxim and scrutinised financial controls, success will be ensured. Our products will exceed the expectations of our customers.

How bleach works

Bleach is a chemical compound derived from natural sources and used to whiten fabrics. It works by oxidation — the alteration of a compound by the introduction of oxygen molecules. A stain is essentially a chemical compound, and bleach breaks those molecules into smaller elements so they separate from the fabric. Detergent and the agitation of the washing machine speed up the process. The disinfecting properties of bleach work the same way: germs are broken down and rendered harmless by the introduction of oxygen.
